claims.claim: Candidate descends from the TASK-163 author commit and changes only the certification module and two authorized roadmaps, with production authorities unchanged.
The live fixture validates bounded Shopee configuration, uses one CDP manager and discovery call, and performs two planned acquisitions of the selected listing with the same scraper and manager.
The fixture composes one TASK-138 intake and TASK-139 plan into one governed family and two singleton variants persisted through TASK-140/141 and TASK-120.
Persistent grounded QA reloads the durable catalog and exact manifests once using the exact question, max_hits=2, and one deterministic zero-network provider.

Live failures are reduced to bounded sanitized categories, traceback output is disabled, logging is suppressed at the failure boundary, and cleanup is attempted exactly once without masking primary failure.
The required live module and offline structural checks are present, the committed worktree is clean, and canonical verification remains reserved for Runtime.
Both roadmaps record TASK-154 closure, TASK-156 historical failure, TASK-162 publication, and TASK-163's publication-stable conditional P6.0b/P6.0 closure gate with P6.1 next only after PASS.
